Class AnimatedArchitecturePlugin

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.plugin.PluginBase
org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.spigot.core.AnimatedArchitecturePlugin
All Implemented Interfaces:
IAnimatedArchitecturePlatformProvider, org.bukkit.command.CommandExecutor, org.bukkit.command.TabCompleter, org.bukkit.command.TabExecutor, org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin
@Singleton public final class AnimatedArchitecturePlugin extends org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin implements IAnimatedArchitecturePlatformProvider
Represents the base JavaPlugin for AnimatedArchitecture.

This is the entry point of the Spigot platform.

Refer to nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.spigot.core for more information on how to interact with this plugin.

      public Optional<IAnimatedArchitecturePlatform> getPlatform()
      Description copied from interface: IAnimatedArchitecturePlatformProvider
      Gets the platform loaded on the server.

      This method may return an empty Optional if the platform is not available.

      The platform can be unavailable if it failed to load or if the server is running an unsupported platform.
